sections.experience: /experience$ tail -f career.log Head of Data Science Braidr (Tomorrow Group) | London | Sep 2021 – Present Built the agency's data science function from zero into a working multidisciplinary practice. Lead a seven-person team of ML, data and cloud engineers, solution architects and analysts across London and Romania. Set how the practice runs: career development, sprint rhythms, a culture of direct feedback. Own Braidr's long-term data science and AI strategy across eighteen client industries, and decide where it makes the agency money. Introduced the scoping framework Braidr now runs every project through, which prices thinking rather than output and protects engineering time. DS-led engagements have delivered £12.1M predicted incremental revenue from optimised media planning (a British train operating company), 5M+ documents processed at 98% accuracy (a leading mortgage network), a 4x conversion uplift (a hotel group), and a 12% revenue recovery via first-party data capture (a tour operator). Architected Luminr from scratch and scaled it into an enterprise product analysing hundreds of millions of search results across Google, Amazon and TikTok. Took it to the Web Summit AI startup showcase twice. Led an ML deployment from prototype to production for a €33M software distributor: XGBoost trained with Vertex AI distributed training, Dataflow pipelines, FastAPI on Cloud Run serving millions of requests a day, beating the client's existing models by 5-14% in live traffic. Held heavy text embedding models under 100ms latency, and calibrated output probabilities with isotonic regression where they had to be trustworthy. Co-built AI.M.E., Braidr's multi-agent AI maturity framework, benchmarking organisations across capability, governance and deployment. Now central to how Braidr wins work in RegTech, professional services and enterprise software. Also set the principles for the agency's AI for Good work and lead its delivery. Lead the internal agentic AI strategy: operational agents with LLM orchestration on LiteLLM and a graph memory layer on Memgraph, built largely with Claude Code. Authored the Secure Development Lifecycle and core cloud policies that carried the agency through ISO 27001 certification, and standardised the basics underneath: version control on Bitbucket, containerised deployments with Docker. Wrote the first version of Braidr's AI governance framework, agent tiering and centralised credentials so no agent runs on privileged client keys. Senior Data Scientist (Progressed from Data Analyst & Data Scientist) Found (Tomorrow Group) | London, UK | Nov 2015 – Aug 2021 Six years and three job titles, ending up leading the marketing-focused data science work. Ran client insight projects end to end and drove internal R&D. Commercial Impact & Pitching: Packaged complex analysis into client-facing deliverables and presented it directly to stakeholders. The data science work became a pitch differentiator; more than one client named it as the reason they signed. Machine Learning & R&D: Engineered internal machine learning models to classify user intent, improving how campaigns were targeted. Search Demand Innovation: Developed novel statistical approaches to measure and analyse search demand, integrating these tools into the daily workflows of internal teams to drive client strategy. Technical Leadership: Mentored junior data analysts and scientists, and led cross-functional project pods, which led naturally into the Braidr role. Core Technologies: Python (pandas, NumPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn), R (plyr, caret, Shiny), SQL, GCP, Data Visualisation (ggplot2, Bokeh). Freelance Science Writer The Positive | Nov 2014 – Aug 2015 Translated complex scientific and health research into accurate, accessible writing for a readership of over 80,000. Liaised directly with global research teams and evaluated methodologies. Good training for explaining why a model is wrong to a client who really wants it to be right. Analyst, Technology Division HSBC Global Banking & Markets | Aug 2013 – Dec 2014 Built VBA automation for financial data workflows and collaborated with international stakeholders to redesign the team's change control system. My first proper encounter with the gap between what technology promises and what it actually delivers under pressure.
